sources.title: Grok-2 — Grokipedia
sources.snippet: Grok-2 Grok-2 is a multimodal large language model developed by xAI as a successor to prior Grok iterations, released in beta on August 13, 2024, with variants including the full Grok-2 and the lighter Grok-2 mini, emphasizing advancements in chat interactions, coding, reasoning, and vision processing.
